label: UX Research Plan
description: Design a rigorous user research methodology: select methods, write discussion guides, define participant criteria, and plan analysis.

modelTier.notes: Sonnet sufficient for most research planning. Opus for complex multi-method longitudinal studies.

guidedInputs.label: Research Goals
guidedInputs.description: What questions are you trying to answer? What decisions will this research inform?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Understand why users abandon checkout. Validate that new navigation is intuitive.

guidedInputs.label: Target User Types
guidedInputs.description: Who are the users you need to research?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. First-time buyers aged 25-45, mobile-first. B2B procurement managers at mid-size companies.

guidedInputs.label: Product / Service
guidedInputs.description: What product or service is this research about?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Mobile banking app, e-commerce checkout, internal HR portal

guidedInputs.label: Timeline
guidedInputs.description: How much time is available for the research?

guidedInputs.label: Constraints & Considerations
guidedInputs.description: Budget, access to users, legal/privacy restrictions, remote vs in-person, etc.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Remote only, GDPR consent required, budget £5k, limited access to B2B users
